newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran cleric says EU row fans anti-West mood.
newsitem.headline: Iran cleric says EU row fans anti-West mood.

text.p: A senior Iranian cleric on Friday warned the European Union that pressuring Iran during the current diplomatic row would only fan stronger anti-Western sentiments in the country.

"Because of your decisions and your loud propaganda, our people are becoming every day more anti-American, more anti-Israeli and more opposed to your union and more steadfast in their stances," Ayatollah Ahmad Jannati said at a mass prayer gathering in Tehran. His sermon was broadcast on Tehran radio.

He was referring to decisions by a meeting of EU foreign ministers in Luxembourg this week which suspended ministerial contacts with Iran after a German court verdict accused Tehran leaders of ordering the 1992 killings of Kurdish dissidents in Berlin. Iran has denied involvement.
"The one which considers itself a superpower was unable to do anything against us...What can you do who have no power left?," said Jannati in reference to United States sanctions against Iran.
"We will not lose over this. Of course we will be inconvenienced, but you will be the losers," said the cleric who is the secretary of the powerful Guardian Council.
Iran has reacted to the EU decisions by saying it would not allow the German and Danish ambassadors to return to Tehran.
The Luxembourg meeting had decided that EU envoys, withdrawn for consultations after the April 10 verdict, could return.
